description: A nootropic mist for the overclocked mind. Clarity in a can, with interest.

overdose.message: It's too much. Your mind goes white and doesn't come back.

phases.end_message: It wears off. You can't think clearly any more.
phases.peak_message: Your head clears. Every problem looks easy.

effects.take_line: You breathe in a lungful of {name}.

withdrawal.message: You can't focus. Everything around you demands your attention at once.

stages.easing: You can follow one thing at a time. It's a start.
stages.onset: The clear head is gone in an instant, and you lose track of what you were doing.
stages.peak: Your focus is gone, and everything in the room is fighting for your attention at once.
stages.rising: You read a page and none of it sticks. You read it again. Still nothing.
stages.tail: Your focus is back to normal. You notice how much sharper it used to be.

name: Static
